comment: The maker's tooltip calls inputs 9 to 11 'Size CV'; the manual calls the same jacks the 'Space Input'. The panel prints no lettering at all, only icons, so neither name is visible in the rack. The lines describe what the code does: the voltage is added to the warp knob and clamped. Rows 2 and 3 normal upwards while Internal Routing is on: their clock, V/oct, size and spin jacks each read the same jack on the row above when they have no cable of their own, so one cable at the top can drive all three rows.
